mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0 and remains elevated for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO increases for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0 and remains elevated for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals robust labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months above 200,000
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 months above 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 1,500 signals improving housing demand and construction activity, which boosts related sectors and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1,500 and remains elevated for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 1,500 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in CPI inflation below 2% signals easing price pressures, which reduces the risk of aggressive monetary tightening and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses below 2.0 and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
